delegation.quote: For Curator ABC and Graph membership use, you should make the decision for me
delegation.rationale: Internal, no-display, no-redistribution graph-membership use of this one fact is strictly narrower than the fact-only paid_product_display the Chairman already ruled covered on 2026-10-11 for the same source bytes; it adds no audience, no quotation, no magnitude and no redistribution.

question: May the C01 Micron ruling be revised to add graph_membership_use (internal graph use only, no display, no redistribution, same source hash)?
answer: YES - decided by the assigned seat under the Chairman's explicit 2026-11-02 delegation of this question.
scope_limits: Grants only internal graph-membership use of the one ratified activity proposal named in proposal_ids, over the exact source bytes bound in source.
display=false and redistribution=false: no new audience, quotation, magnitude, ranking, sizing or trade authority is granted by this revision.
The 2026-10-11 ruling's permitted_use is copied verbatim and is neither widened nor narrowed here.
Does not assert a license document was independently inspected; other editions, facts, vendors and sources are outside this record.
Ordinary authenticity, identity, curation, release and production acceptance remain required.
